# Njumwa Labs

> Njumwa Labs is the software, automation and data studio of Crispus Martin Njumwa — a Microsoft-certified Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations technical consultant based in Nairobi, Kenya, holding three Microsoft Solution Architect Expert certifications (D365 F&O, Azure, Power Platform). He builds, automates and maintains production systems for SMEs, startups and enterprises locally and worldwide (Kenya, United States, United Kingdom, European Union, and the Gulf), at enterprise quality and globally affordable prices.

Tagline: Automation and efficiency brought closer.

## Credentials (verified)

- Microsoft Solution Architect Expert ×3: Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, Azure, Power Platform.
- Microsoft Associate ×5: D365 F&O Developer, Power Platform Developer, Azure Administrator, Power BI Data Analyst, Fabric Analytics Engineer.
- AI/Data/Foundations: Microsoft AI Business Professional; Career Essentials in Generative AI; Machine Learning Specialization (DeepLearning.AI / Stanford); CS50 Python (Harvard / edX).
- Real delivery: technical components on a 200+ user Dynamics 365 F&O insurance ERP go-live across General Ledger, AR, AP, Fixed Assets, Inventory and Procurement.
- BSc Computer Science, Egerton University. Currently D365 F&O Developer at Impax Business Solutions, Nairobi.

- Web development — websites, web apps, SaaS, e-commerce, APIs; React, Next.js, Astro, Node.js, Python; SEO and Core Web Vitals. https://njumwalabs.com/services/web-development/
- AI automation — chatbots & support agents, AI lead generation, workflow automation (n8n/Make/Zapier), document processing, voice AI, RAG copilots. https://njumwalabs.com/services/ai-automation/

- Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations — X++ (Chain of Command), integrations, DMF data migration, SSRS & Electronic Reporting, Power BI, upgrades, security, Power Platform. https://njumwalabs.com/services/dynamics-365-finance-operations/

## Dynamics 365 & Copilot content cluster

In-depth, source-verified guides on Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, Microsoft Copilot and building agents with Copilot Studio. Written by Crispus (Microsoft-certified, Solution Architect Expert x3) and grounded in current Microsoft documentation; each article states whether a feature is generally available, in preview or planned.

- Copilot in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: what it actually does — the sidecar, embedded AI summaries and agents; how Copilot is built on Copilot Studio and Azure-hosted LLMs via Dataverse. https://njumwalabs.com/blog/copilot-dynamics-365-finance-operations/
- How to enable Copilot in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations — Power Platform Integration in Lifecycle Services, required Dynamics 365 apps, the "Publish bots with AI features" tenant setting, Bing Search and cross-region data movement, and a troubleshooting order for when the Copilot button doesn't appear. https://njumwalabs.com/blog/enable-copilot-dynamics-365-finance-operations/
- From Copilot chat to AI agents: the 2026 agentic shift in Dynamics 365 — the Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server, agent identities and security roles, agent management, what's GA vs production-ready preview, and how agents are billed. https://njumwalabs.com/blog/dynamics-365-ai-agents-2026-agentic-shift/
- What is Microsoft Copilot Studio? A plain-English guide for businesses — agents, topics, knowledge, tools, triggers, generative orchestration, channels, and usage-based Copilot Credits pricing. https://njumwalabs.com/blog/what-is-copilot-studio/
- How to build your first agent in Copilot Studio (step by step) — prerequisites and licensing, creating an agent from a description or template, knowledge, tools, testing and publishing. https://njumwalabs.com/blog/build-first-agent-copilot-studio/
- Autonomous agents in Copilot Studio: triggers, tools and guardrails — event triggers, instruction writing, guardrails, the "agent reasons, flow executes" pattern, and a safe rollout sequence. https://njumwalabs.com/blog/autonomous-agents-copilot-studio/
- How to keep up with Dynamics 365 and Copilot updates (without drowning) — release waves vs service updates, the One Version cadence, early access and previews, the Message Center, and building a Microsoft Learn MCP documentation agent. https://njumwalabs.com/blog/keep-up-dynamics-365-copilot-updates/
- Comparison: Copilot Studio vs Power Automate vs custom code — reasoning vs rules vs control, cost models and a verdict. https://njumwalabs.com/compare/copilot-studio-vs-power-automate-vs-custom-code/
- Definitions: https://njumwalabs.com/glossary/copilot-studio/ , https://njumwalabs.com/glossary/autonomous-agent/ , https://njumwalabs.com/glossary/agentic-ai/ , https://njumwalabs.com/glossary/model-context-protocol/ , https://njumwalabs.com/glossary/generative-orchestration/ , https://njumwalabs.com/glossary/copilot-sidecar/

Note: these articles track fast-moving Microsoft features and are reviewed each release wave. Always confirm current availability, prerequisites and licensing against Microsoft Learn for your own tenant.

## Pricing summary

Globally affordable, transparent. Projects from ~$600; product builds from ~$1,800; managed retainers from ~$300/month; consulting (incl. D365 F&O) from ~$45/hour. Prices in USD; local (KES) and custom pricing available.
